senses.definition: n.pr.m. father of Elḥanan 2 S 21:19 (= יָעִו֯ר 1 Ch 20:5); א׳ prob. scribal error anticipating א׳ in foll. line (We Dr), and יַעֲרֵי error for יָעִיר (We) q.v. sub עור.
